full_name_original: Aluminium-Industrie-Aktien-Gesellschaft (French: S.A. pour l'Industrie de l'Aluminium)

full_name_original: S.A. l'Energie de l'Ouest-Suisse (Energie Ouest Suisse)

full_name_original: Forces Motrices de la Gougra SA
description: Gougra hydropower company (Moiry dam; Mottec, Vissoie and Navizence plants)

history_and_status: Founded 1952. Initial shareholders: ATEL 30%, AIAG 30%, Louis de Roll 30%, Union Bank of Switzerland 6%, Sierre municipality 4%. Current shareholders: Alpiq 54%, Rhonewerke 27.5%, Anniviers 7.71%, Sierre 7.5%, Chippis 1.79%, OIKEN 1.0%, Chalais 0.5%

notes: FMG is the direct concession holder; Alpiq is the controlling shareholder, not the concession holder
